title: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI Release Summary (2025)

blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per operating system (OS) for the Zscaler Client Connector for VDI on Zscaler Cloud & Branch Connector.

blocks.heading: December 19, 2025
Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.6 for Windows 1.7.0.6
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.6 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Adds a logic to reattempt the initial policy fetch in the event of failure.

blocks.heading: November 07, 2025
Feature in Limited Availability: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.4 for Windows 1.7.0.4
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.7.0.4 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Contains a new installer parameter, SHOWREAUTHNOTIFICATION, which makes reauthentication notifications configurable.
Fixes an issue where the user does not receive a notification from Zscaler Client Connector for VDI when a Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) timeout policy is activated.

blocks.heading: October 31, 2025
Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.6.0.6 for Windows 1.6.0.6
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.6.0.6 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector for VDI was crashing due to a race condition when the system shut down.

blocks.heading: October 03, 2025
Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.6.0.5 for Windows 1.6.0.5
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.6.0.5 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Fixes an issue that stopped the control channel from restarting when sending outbound packets and not receiving inbound packets.

blocks.heading: August 12, 2025
Feature in Limited Availability: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.6.0.3 for Windows 1.6.0.3
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.6.0.3 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Improves the stability of the Zscaler Client Connector for VDI control channel.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.5.0.8 for Windows 1.5.0.8
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.5.0.8 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Fixes an issue where WebView2 has intermittent issues with the discovery of PAC settings.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.5.0.7 for Windows 1.5.0.7
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.5.0.7 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Client Connector for VDI application window did not open for some users.
Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector for VDI dropped traffic as a non-standard user.

blocks.heading: March 31, 2025
Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.5.0.5 for Windows 1.5.0.5
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.5.0.5 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Adds a registry option to prevent Zscaler Client Connector for VDI from onboarding on system reboot.

blocks.heading: February 07, 2025
Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.4.0.8 for Windows 1.4.0.8
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.4.0.8 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.text: Fixes an error that caused control channel connections to fail when the certificate had not expired.

blocks.heading: January 06, 2025
Feature Available: Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.4.0.7 for Windows 1.4.0.7
Zscaler Client Connector for VDI 1.4.0.7 Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Increases the authorization timeout from 60 seconds to 180 seconds.
Fixes an issue where default policies in Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) forwarding profiles were not bypassed.
